title: Worker Capsule Schema
description: Defines the input capsule passed to each Worker Agent before spawn. fork_context MUST be false.

agentId.description: Codex agent ID after spawn. Optional before spawn, required after.

forkContext.description: MUST be false. Workers receive clean context.

worktreePath.description: Absolute or run-relative path to worker's exclusive worktree.

ownedFiles.description: Files the Worker is allowed and required to create/modify.

forbiddenFiles.description: Files the Worker MUST NOT access. Empty list = isolation violation.

allowedDependencies.description: Packages and imports the Worker is allowed to use.

forbiddenDependencies.description: Packages and imports the Worker MUST NOT use.

requiredExports.description: Function/class/type names the Worker must export with exact signatures.

requiredEvidenceOutputs.description: Evidence files the Worker must produce (test results, typecheck output, etc.).

requiredScenarios.description: Behavioral scenarios the Worker must handle.

requiredNegativeControls.description: Negative/failure scenarios the Worker must test.

inputContextSummary.description: Brief (under 500 chars) summary of what the Worker needs to know about the project.

excludedContext.description: Explicitly excluded context items (full conversation history, other worker capsules, phase lock internals, etc.).

handoffRequirements.description: Handoff artifacts the Worker must produce before close.

mailboxRequirements.description: Mailbox handoff requirements if agent-mailbox/ exists.

validationRules.forkContextMustBeFalse: forkContext must equal false. True = FAIL_PROFILE_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION.
validationRules.worktreePathRequired: worktreePath must be a non-empty string.
validationRules.ownedFilesNonEmpty: ownedFiles must contain at least one file.
validationRules.forbiddenFilesNonEmpty: forbiddenFiles must contain at least one forbidden path. Empty = isolation violation.
validationRules.requiredEvidenceNonEmpty: requiredEvidenceOutputs must contain at least one evidence item.
validationRules.noOtherWorkerCapsules: Input context must not contain another worker's capsule content.
